comments.author: @LifewaysTravel
comments.text: Guam is more complex than most people realize. What surprised you most about daily life on the island? I’d love to hear your thoughts, and thanks for watching!

comments.author: @edhutson6955
comments.text: Stationed there with my family Mar 1962 to 1964 great memories wonderful people. Geckos were pretty much inside every home the only time I ever saw them was at night occasionally one would drop in on you while you were sleeping. Typhoon memories of eating spam cooked on a sterno stove by candlelight for a few weeks. Hey not griping people pay big money for that type of ambiance.

replies.author: @LifewaysTravel
replies.text: What an incredible set of memories. From geckos in the house to cooking Spam by candlelight after a typhoon, those details really bring that time in Guam to life. Thank you for sharing such a personal piece of your family's story with us. ❤️
